mn115:16.3: ‘It’s impossible for bad conduct of speech …
mn115:16.4: or bad conduct of mind to have a likable, desirable, agreeable result.’ They understand this.
mn115:16.5: But it is possible for bad conduct of speech …
mn115:16.6: or bad conduct of mind to have an unlikable, undesirable, disagreeable result. They understand this.
mn115:17.3: ‘It’s impossible for good conduct of speech …
mn115:17.4: or good conduct of mind to have an unlikable, undesirable, disagreeable result.’ They understand this.
mn115:17.5: ‘But it is possible for good conduct of speech …
mn115:17.6: or good conduct of mind to have a likable, desirable, agreeable result.’ They understand this.
mn115:19.1: ‘It’s impossible that someone who has engaged in bad conduct of speech …
mn115:19.2: or bad conduct of mind could, for that reason alone, when their body breaks up, after death, be reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.’ They understand this.
mn115:19.3: ‘But it is possible that someone who has engaged in bad conduct of speech …
mn115:19.4: or bad conduct of mind could, for that reason alone, when their body breaks up, after death, be reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.’ They understand this.
mn115:19.7: ‘It’s impossible that someone who has engaged in good conduct of speech …
mn115:19.8: or good conduct of mind could, for that reason alone, when their body breaks up, after death, be reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.’ They understand this.
mn115:19.9: ‘But it is possible that someone who has engaged in good conduct of speech …
mn115:19.10: or good conduct of mind could, for that reason alone, when their body breaks up, after death, be reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.’ They understand this.
